planner_json.title: Exit-0 denials and hidden image judging are observed per keyed harness, and each graded row cites evidence a reader can open
provides: per-leg exit0-denied-read and hidden-image-judge observations on each pinned keyed cell
consumes: GAW-1 runProbe capture records and smoke/control-probe.mjs
boundary_contracts: probe capture to cell record: a denial is read through table-driven events, and an unobservable control reads could-not-run by name
depends_on: GAW-1 (the runProbe capture records and the control-probe.mjs CLI this observer attaches from)

write_prohibited: tests/sprint-01/** - locked; t13 and t15 read observations.mjs
test/harness/controls/** - GAW-8 owns `.controls[]` and its merge
test/harness/stream/** - E1 owns the table-driven layer this reads
test/harness/adapters/** - GAW-1 owns runProbe and controlProbeEntry

dispatched_run.description: One finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect with its real artifacts
records: run_id re-fetched on every cold boot, never hard-coded

committed_real_capture.description: The real claude-code run committed by T15: CLI 2.1.314, process exit 0, one model request, a Bash denial and a Write denial, and no question

specification.objective: Each pinned keyed cell records its own exit0-denied-read and hidden-image-judge observation, a denial on exit 0 reads fail, and every first-cited evidence path opens inside that leg's exported artifact.
specification.success_state: On a finished run at HEAD, 5 pinned harnesses open every first-cited evidence path, claude-code reads exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call with process_exit_code 0, and 5 pinned cells read no-image-judge-in-child-tree.

requirements.title: Each pinned keyed cell opens its cited evidence and records its own denial and image observations
requirements.description: GIVEN `dispatched_run`, a finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on the landed commit WHEN the maintainer downloads the result and each pinned leg's evidence artifact, then opens the first evidence path of every check row of the five pinned cells THEN 5 harnesses open every first-cited path, claude-code reads exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call with exit 0, and 5 cells read no-image-judge-in-child-tree
requirements.positive_example: A run where all five pinned harnesses open every first-cited evidence path inside their harness-eval-evidence artifact, and claude-code reads exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call with process_exit_code 0.
requirements.red: Run 41235273928: check rows carry no evidence_paths, the cell-level `cell/evidence/...` paths sit in no artifact because each cell artifact holds cell.json alone, and only claude-code carries control observations.
requirements.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

scenario.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

would_fail_if: evidence paths point at a runner that no longer exists, so nothing they cite can be opened
the denial observer reads only claude-code's result event and stays empty on the other harnesses
a verdict is derived from the process exit code

examples: jq prints `claude-code fail denied_tool_call exit=0` from cells[].control_observations
each harness's first cited path opens inside its downloaded evidence artifact

build_proof.range: anything that proves each keyed cell's grades cite bytes a reader can open, and that a denial observed on exit 0 reads fail
examples: per-harness observations attached to each cell record beside the existing four .controls rows

steps: resolve the newest completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals `git rev-parse HEAD`
download the result and each pinned leg's harness-eval-evidence artifact
open the first evidence path of every check row of the five pinned cells

must_observe: `5` harnesses each open every first-cited path, so `0` paths are missing
`claude-code` pinned reads exit0-denied-read verdict `fail`, reason `denied_tool_call`, evidence.process_exit_code `0`
must_not_observe: a cited path that no downloaded artifact holds, the reading of run 41235273928

requirements.title: A denial read through a harness's table on exit 0 fails, and a harness with no gate says so by name
requirements.description: GIVEN `committed_real_capture`, the real claude-code run with exit 0 and a Write denial WHEN the observer reads it through a temp table at 2.1.314 with the Write target required, with no target required, and on a Pi leg THEN the required case reads fail denied_tool_call with exit 0, the optional case reads optional-denial-not-a-failure, and Pi reads could-not-run stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable
requirements.positive_example: The committed capture, exit 0, read through a temp copy of the claude table at 2.1.314: the observer returns fail denied_tool_call naming Write with process_exit_code 0, and a Pi leg returns could-not-run stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable.
requirements.red: On base no observer takes a harness and a table, and runControlProbe is hard-wired to the claude binary, so the import fails.
requirements.verification_service: the real denial observer and image scanner over a committed real claude-code capture

scenario.verification_service: the real denial observer and image scanner over a committed real claude-code capture

would_fail_if: the observer still reads only claude's own line mapper, so another harness's denial stays absent
a stubbed observation is returned with no capture read
a verdict equals the value exitCodeVerdict returns for exit `0`

build_proof.range: anything that proves a denial read from a harness's table-driven events on exit 0 fails the grade, and that a harness with no denial surface says so by name
examples: a neutral observer fed by normalise and streamDenials

steps: observe the capture through a temp table declaring 2.1.314, with its Write target declared required
observe the same capture with no path declared required and the Write target outside them

must_observe: no `denied_tool_call` verdict, and reason `optional-denial-not-a-failure` on the pair

steps: ask for the observation on a Pi leg, whose table declares required-read-denial not applicable

must_not_observe: a fabricated denial with no offset

requirements.title: Each leg scans its own tree, a planted image fails, and an unreadable tree is not a pass
requirements.description: GIVEN `committed_real_capture`'s real stream in a scratch directory WHEN the scanner runs on it as a codex leg, on two planted copies, and on a root that does not exist THEN the real stream reads no-image-judge-in-child-tree naming codex, both planted copies read fail image-judge-in-child-tree, and the missing root reads could-not-run control-unobservable
requirements.positive_example: The committed real stream scans pass no-image-judge-in-child-tree with the leg's harness named in its evidence. The same bytes plus one planted `"type":"image"` line, or one planted `"mime":"image/png"` file part, read fail image-judge-in-child-tree.
requirements.red: On base observeLeg takes no harness, so the observation names none, and IMAGE_PATTERNS has no `mime` shape, so a planted file part scans pass.
requirements.verification_service: the real denial observer and image scanner over a committed real claude-code capture

scenario.verification_service: the real denial observer and image scanner over a committed real claude-code capture

would_fail_if: the scanner is stubbed to always pass, which the planted twin catches
a tree it could not read reports pass on an empty scan

build_proof.range: anything that proves each keyed leg records its own scan of what its verify runs produced, that the scan can find an image in that harness's stream shape, and that an unreadable tree is not a pass
examples: observeLeg taking the leg's harness, and scan patterns extended from real captures

steps: scan a directory holding the real stream as a codex leg
append one planted image content block to a scratch copy and scan
append one planted `mime` file part to a scratch copy and scan

must_observe: both planted scans: verdict `fail`, reason `image-judge-in-child-tree`, with a byte offset

steps: scan a root that does not exist

must_observe: the observer returns `null`, and the cell row reads `could-not-run` `control-unobservable`
must_not_observe: an empty scan read as evidence

test_criteria.statement: Every first-cited evidence path opens inside its pinned leg's evidence artifact when the run at HEAD finishes
The claude-code pinned cell reads exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call beside evidence.process_exit_code 0
Five pinned cells read hidden-image-judge reason no-image-judge-in-child-tree when the run at HEAD finishes
The committed capture reads fail denied_tool_call naming Write beside process_exit_code 0 when its Write target is required
The committed capture reads optional-denial-not-a-failure when no path is declared required
A Pi leg reads `could-not-run` `stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable` when its table declares required-read-denial not applicable
A scratch copy with a planted image content block reads fail image-judge-in-child-tree
The cell row reads `could-not-run` `control-unobservable` when the observer returns null

integration_obligations.completion_rule: FLOW-GRD-03-FILES-AND-STREAM passes on the trunk when `node --test --test-name-pattern 'FLOW-GRD-03-FILES-AND-STREAM' tests/sprint-02/grd-03-files-and-stream.test.mjs` exits 0 against a completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals the trunk candidate, and its artifact .tmp/sprint-02-verification/grd-03-files-and-stream.json is retained with its expected observations matched.
